proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ _ A B h
  ext g
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, iff_true, Finset.mem_image₂]
  have hd : ¬ Disjoint A (B.image (fun b => g - b)) := by
    intro hd
    have h1 := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd
    have h2 : (B.image (fun b => g - b)).card = B.card := Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (sub_right_injective)
    have h3 := Finset.card_le_univ (A ∪ B.image (fun b => g - b))
    omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ := Finset.not_disjoint_iff.mp hd
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx2
  exact ⟨g - b, hx1, b, hb, sub_add_cancel g b⟩
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] (A B : Finset G), Fintype.card G < A.card + B.card → Finset.image₂ (· + ·) A B = Finset.univ
